chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Salih ibn Sindy, from Ibn Sinan, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Breaking the fast upon water washes the sins from the heart.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of breaking a fast with water according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the spiritual efficacy of breaking the fast with water, a practice rooted in the Sunnah that serves as a means of divine mercy. This narration underscores the concept of *ghusl al-qalb* (cleansing of the heart), suggesting that the simplicity of the act facilitates the removal of spiritual impurities accumulated during the day's worship.
